caseNameFull: School District No. 1, Denver, Colorado v. Keyes and Congress of Hispanic Educators v. School District No. 1, Denver, Colorado

opinions.text:
C. A. 10th Cir. Motion of Puerto Rican Legal Defense & Education Fund, Inc., for leave to file a brief as amicus curiae in No. 75-702 granted. Certiorari denied.

Mr. Justice White took no part in the consideration or decision of this motion and petitions.

Reported below: 521 F. 2d 465.
